preconditions.description: Input strings s and t have equal length and s is lexicographically smaller than t.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'No such string' or (stdout != 'No such string' and len(stdout) == len(s) and s < stdout < t)
postconditions.description: If no valid string exists, output 'No such string'. Otherwise, output a string of the same length as s and t, lexicographically greater than s and smaller than t.
